title: Community Solar Subscriptions Invoice Line Corrections and Care Desk Authority
content:
## Standard

1. **Form of a correction.** An over-invoiced Community Solar Subscriptions subscription line is corrected by one rebill credit tied to it, the rebill credit naming the line it corrects, equal to the invoiced amount less the correct amount.
2. **Time limit.** A solar line may be corrected only when the subscriber disputes it no later than the plan's correction period, in calendar months, after the line was posted. The lookback ends on the same day of the month that many months after the posted date, or on the last day of that month when that day does not exist. A dispute made on the last day of the lookback is within it. The posted date is read from the system record of the line disputed.
3. **Care desk authority.** A care agent may post up to the plan's per-line limit on one line; larger corrections, and disputes about the credit value the utility applied, are outside care-desk authority.

A rebill credit reduces the net amount Beacon Ridge has invoiced the subscriber.

## Lookback boundaries (hypothetical dates, 12-month correction period)

| Line posted | Lookback ends | Dispute on | Within the lookback |
|---|---|---|---|
| 15 January 2025 | 15 January 2026 | 15 January 2026 | Yes |
| 15 January 2025 | 15 January 2026 | 16 January 2026 | No |
| 29 February 2024 | 28 February 2025 (no 29 February in 2025) | 28 February 2025 | Yes |
| 31 August 2024 | 31 August 2025 | 1 September 2025 | No |

## Amounts (hypothetical)

- A line invoiced at $74.25 whose correct amount is $66.00 is corrected by one rebill credit of $8.25.
- With a per-line limit of $100.00: a correction of $8.25 is within a care agent's authority; a correction of $130.00 on one line is larger than the limit and outside care-desk authority.
- A dispute about the value of the solar credit the utility applied is outside care-desk authority whatever the amount.
